Stephen is the GM (General Manager) of a new AWS service under development, and author of the book "Ahead in the Cloud: Best Practices for Navigating the Future of Enterprise IT". Stephen spent his first three-and-a-half years with Amazon as the Global Head of Enterprise Strategy, where he oversaw AWS's enterprise go-to-market strategy, invented and built AWS's Migration Acceleration Program (MAP), and helped executives from hundreds of the world's largest companies envision, develop, and mature their IT operating model using the cloud.
